summary: The exact candidate is a justified source-level partial fix: it removes EAGLE's inflated two-step KV reserve from the capacity check and allocation, uses synchronous target sequence lengths, retains UNO compatibility, and supplies a fallback when seq_lens_cpu is absent. Failing-before/passing-after and independent boundary evidence verifies those accounting contracts. The original GLM-DSA NVFP4 TP8 B200 cache-hit and TTFT recovery remains unverified on the available architecture.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression on the recorded base: 3 failed and 1 passed because the base lacks synchronous base_kv_lens sizing and decode_seq_lens_from_reqs. Raw log: /job/review-evidence-j-d944deffd8db/base-candidate-regression.log

5 passed: one-step EAGLE sizing at page sizes 1 and 8, legacy committed-length behavior, encoder image-token adjustment, and unchanged UNO double reserve. Raw log: /job/review-evidence-j-d944deffd8db/candidate-focused.log

Independent checks of capacity/allocation agreement for selected subsets, stale committed lengths, page rounding, missing seq_lens_cpu, encoder adjustment, already-overallocated rows, and fail-loud length mismatch. Raw log: /job/review-evidence-j-d944deffd8db/adversarial-candidate-final.log
All changed source modules compiled and the candidate diff had no whitespace errors. Import inspection resolved all changed modules from /job/repo/python/sglang.

gpu_execution_evidence: The only assigned accelerator is AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2. It cannot execute or qualify the reported CUDA modelopt_fp4 TP8 B200 path, and an unrelated GPU arithmetic smoke was intentionally not used as issue evidence.
remaining_counterexamples: No run demonstrates that deep sequential multi-turn GLM-5.2 DSA NVFP4 EAGLE traffic recovers cached_tokens/prompt_tokens from the reported 40–53% toward the 97% no-spec baseline.
No run demonstrates recovery of the reported TTFT or input-token throughput on TP8 B200.
The separately reported EAGLE max-running-requests=256 CUDA-graph illegal-address crash was not exercised and is not established as fixed by this allocator change.
remaining_limitations: Available hardware is one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2, not eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs under CUDA.
GLM-5.2 744B MoE DSA NVFP4 target weights, compatible EAGLE draft weights, TP8, and the original multi-turn workload were unavailable.
The deterministic tiny-Llama fixture has no EAGLE draft checkpoint and can validate only transport and ordinary engine execution, so it was not used as proof of this issue.
No C++ or other native source changed in the candidate; consequently no native rebuild was applicable.
